sys_remote_update_set.description: Qualys CI lookup rules (USEM custom chain, orders 175 to 850) rewritten for readability. Each rule script opens with the sample Qualys Host Detection payload it handles, explains why the rule sits at its order and which hosts reach it, and walks the logic line by line with example values. Result sets are no longer capped with setLimit: a rule accepts a CI only when exactly one candidate remains, or, for the tie-break rules, when the scanned IP confirms one of several candidates. Matching behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
sys_remote_update_set.name: SNOWUSEMTP-895_MS_Qualys CI Lookup Rules_V2.0
